measurement_contract.grain: one canonical implementation deliverable, not one FLOW
measurement_contract.hour_unit: productive engineering hours including implementation, tests and independent review; excluding calendar waiting and owner decisions
measurement_contract.credit_rule: COMPLETED credit requires cited accepted evidence for the defined deliverable; PARTIAL has no automatic fractional credit
measurement_contract.percent_rule: 100 * sum(estimated_total_hours for accepted COMPLETED deliverables) / sum(estimated_total_hours for all scoped deliverables), only when every row in scope has an approved estimate
measurement_contract.remaining_rule: sum(estimated_remaining_hours) only when every row in scope has a current approved estimate
measurement_contract.unknown_rule: If any required estimate is null, publish null, never zero or a partial-denominator percentage
measurement_contract.gate_rule: Implementation Gate PASS is separate from Business Lock, merged code and the forecast percentage
measurement_contract.revision_rule: Append a versioned estimate_history entry before replacing an approved estimate; never rewrite a prior forecast snapshot
